question: 今年已经缴入国库的非税资金一共有多少？
sql: SELECT sum(treasury_transfer_dedup.ftotalamt) AS "缴库金额" FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY fid) AS _rn FROM yunnan0508.fne_treasury_transfer_new) WHERE _rn = 1) AS treasury_transfer_dedup WHERE treasury_transfer_dedup.fstatus = '9' AND toDate(treasury_transfer_dedup.fmsgdate) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND toDate(treasury_transfer_dedup.fmsgdate) < CAST('2026-10-24' AS DATE) SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
